name: Jet2 plc
summary: Jet2 plc, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the leisure travel business in the United Kingdom. The company offers package holidays to leisure destinations in the Mediterranean, the Canary Islands, and European Leisure Cities; and scheduled holiday flights through its airline. It is also involved in passenger aircraft operations; sale of non-ticket ancillary products, such as hold baggage, advanced seat assignment, and extra legroom; and charter aircraft operations. In addition, the company engages in aircraft leasing, financing, and aviation services.
